labels.name: difficulty: medium
labels.description: Needs some design or several files

issues.title: `taskr done <id>` always says the task does not exist
issues.body:
**Steps to reproduce**

```
taskr add "Buy milk"
taskr done 1
```

**Actual:** `Error: No task with id 1`

**Expected:** task 1 is marked as done.

`taskr remove 1` fails the same way. Please add a test that covers the CLI path.

issues.title: Dates in `taskr list` show the wrong month
issues.body:
A task created on 26 October shows up as `2026-09-26` in `taskr list`. Tasks created in January show month `00`.

The existing format tests don't check the date part, so please add one.

issues.title: `taskr list --sort` shows low-priority tasks first
issues.body: I'd expect `--sort` to put the most important (`high`) tasks at the top, but they end up at the bottom.

issues.title: Two tasks can end up with the same id after removing one
issues.body:
**Steps to reproduce**

```
taskr add a
taskr add b
taskr remove 1
taskr add c
taskr list
```

Both `b` and `c` now have id `2`, so `taskr done 2` is ambiguous.

Ids should be unique and never reused.

issues.title: Only the first `--tag` is used when listing
issues.body:
`taskr add` accepts several `--tag` flags, but `taskr list --tag work --tag urgent` silently ignores `urgent`.

Proposal: show tasks that have **all** the given tags. Update the README to describe the behaviour.

issues.title: Corrupted task file crashes with a raw JSON error
issues.body:
If `~/.taskr.json` contains invalid JSON, every command crashes with `Unexpected token ... in JSON`.

It should print a clear message that names the file path and suggests how to fix it, without overwriting the user's data.

issues.title: Add an `edit` command
issues.body:
Allow changing a task's title, priority or tags:

```
taskr edit 3 --title "New title" --priority high
```

Should include tests and README/help updates.

issues.title: Support due dates
issues.body:
Add `--due YYYY-MM-DD` to `add`, show the due date in `list`, highlight overdue tasks, and add `taskr list --overdue`.

Please comment with a design proposal before starting: how is it stored, how are invalid dates handled, and how does it interact with `--sort`?

issues.title: Add `--json` output to `taskr list`
issues.body: For scripting, `taskr list --json` should print the filtered tasks as a JSON array instead of the human-readable format.

issues.title: Add a `clear` command to delete completed tasks
issues.body: `taskr clear` removes all tasks marked as done and prints how many were removed.

issues.title: Add `taskr search <text>`
issues.body: Case-insensitive search over task titles and tags. Should combine with `--pending`.

issues.title: Tag filtering should be case-insensitive
issues.body: `taskr list --tag Work` doesn't match tasks tagged `work`. Tags should be compared case-insensitively.

issues.title: Add tests for `src/storage.js`
issues.body: `load` and `save` have no tests. Cover: missing file returns `[]`, round-trip save/load, custom path. Use a temporary directory (`fs.mkdtempSync` + `os.tmpdir()`), never the real home directory.

issues.title: Add end-to-end tests for the CLI
issues.body: Nothing tests `bin/taskr.js` today. Add tests that spawn the CLI with `child_process` and a temporary `TASKR_FILE`, covering each command and the error exit code.

issues.title: Document the library API
issues.body: The README has one short library example. Add a section (or `docs/API.md`) documenting every exported function: parameters, return value and errors thrown.

issues.title: Add a FAQ / troubleshooting section to the README
issues.body: Cover: where tasks are stored, how to back them up, how to use a per-project task file with `TASKR_FILE`, and what to do if `taskr` isn't found after `npm link`.
